sentences.text: Today, we will talk about Croatia.
Croatia is a beautiful country in Europe.
Let's learn about it in simple English.
I will speak slowly.
You can listen and repeat if you want.
Where is Croatia?
Croatia is in Europe.
It is in the southeast part of Europe.
It is near the Adriatic Sea.
Croatia has water on one side and mountains on the other side.
It is next to countries like Slovenia, Hungary, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia and Montenegro.
It is a popular country for travel and holidays.
What is the capital city of Croatia?
The capital city is Zagreb.
Zagreb is in the north of the country.
It is the biggest city in Croatia.
Many people live there.
It has museums, parks, shops and beautiful old buildings.
Other famous cities are Split, Dubrovnik and Zadar.
Dubrovnik is very old and very famous.
Many people visit Dubrovnik to see the old city walls and the sea.
How many people live in Croatia?
About 4 million people live in Croatia.
Most people live in cities and towns.
Some people live in small villages.
Croatia also has many islands.
There are over 1,000 islands, but only some have people living on them.
What language do people speak in Croatia?
People speak Croatian.
Croatian is the official language.
It is a Slavic language.
In schools, many children also learn English.
Some people speak German or Italian, especially near the coast.
Tourists can often speak English in big cities.
What is the weather like in Croatia?
The weather in Croatia is different in different places.
Near the sea, it is warm and sunny in the summer.
Many people go to the beach.
In the winter, it is cold and snowy in the mountains.
People can go skiing or stay inside and drink warm tea.
Spring and autumn are cool and nice.
Croatia has four seasons.
What does Croatia look like?
Croatia has many different landscapes.
It has mountains, forests, rivers, and the sea.
There are many beaches and islands.
The water is clear and blue.
Croatia also has national parks.
One famous park is called Plymouth Lakes National Park.
It has waterfalls and green lakes.
It is very beautiful.
What animals live in Croatia?
Croatia has many wild animals.
You can see deer, foxes, wild boars, and sometimes bears in the forests.
In the sea, there are fish, dolphins, and sometimes sea turtles.
Birds are also common in Croatia.
Many people like bird watching in the parks.
What do people eat in Croatia?
Croatian food is delicious.
It is different in every part of the country.
Near the sea, people eat a lot of fish, seafood, and olive oil.
They eat dishes like grilled fish, octopus salad, and black risotto with squid.
In the north and east, people eat more meat, potatoes, and bread.
One popular dish is čevapi.
Čevapi are small grilled meat sausages.
People also eat cheese, soups, and cakes.
Croatia has tasty desserts like palacinka, which are thin pancakes.
What is life like in Croatia?
Life in Croatia is relaxed and family is very important.
People like to spend time outside, drink coffee, and talk with friends.
There are many cafes in every town.
People enjoy music, sports, and traditions.
Soccer is the most popular sport.
The Croatian national team is very good.
They did very well in the World Cup.
People also celebrate many festivals.
They wear traditional clothes and dance to folk music.
Some fun facts about Croatia.
The money in Croatia is now the euro.
Before it was the Kuna.
Croatia became an independent country in 1991.
The Croatian coast is over 1,700 kilometers long.
The necktie, or cravat, comes from Croatia.
The famous TV show Game of Thrones was filmed in Dubrovnik.
Now you know many things about Croatia.
You know where it is.
You know the capital city, the language, and the food.
You know about the sea, the mountains, and the people.
Great work.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
